item.title: Pink Triangle Mountaineering
item.description:
Pink Triangle Mountaineering provides activities into the UK’s mountainous regions, with a focus on activites being open and welcoming to everyone from all backgrounds.

To find out more, do go and check out their instagram page.

item.title: BLJ91A Ltd
item.description:
BLJ91A Ltd is a provider of contracted engineering support, typically operating in the South West of Enland and South Wales. Specialising in electro-mechanical machine automation, the company’s wide background in small and large scale manufacturing, R&D, product design and physical component and system test areas makes it uniquely positioned to support the engineering community.

If you’re keen to know more, please do visit their website here.
